verdict: DECISIVE, but the OPPOSITE of the relight-win hypothesis. (1) The styled warm plate FLAT (A) scores median 7.5 — AT/ABOVE the real-PoE2-art control (6.5), and 4/5 scorers rank A>C. The plate-sprint ARM-B pipeline is ITSELF the cohesion unlock: a warm, firelit, ~1.0-registered painterly plate makes the flat composite read as natively integrated. (2) The #1480 relight (B) REGRESSES hard — median 2.5, UNANIMOUS last place — because it introduces a NEW vertical-banding artifact every scorer named ('vertical/diagonal banding/stripe artifact overlays the whole frame, breaks cohesion badly'). Root cause: the crude shared greybox depth/normal sidecars (2 flat walls + 2 simple pillars) relighting a far richer, high-contrast warm plate (carved pillars, sarcophagus, arch) print through as stripe/seam banding — invisible on iter3's low-contrast COOL plate (same shader+sidecars, no banding), visible here. The relight's own premise (a cool/flat plate needs geometric relighting to add warmth) is INVALIDATED by a plate that arrives warm+firelit: the relight can only darken it and stamp the greybox seams onto it.
recommendation: STOP the relight loop; do NOT port relight to the shipped path. Keep WOSRelight default-OFF (it is already additive / all-uniforms-default-0 / byte-compatible when unset — no shipped code lights it, so nothing to gate off; the #1480 merge stays safe-dormant). The #1481 blocker is RESOLVED, but by the WARM STYLED PLATE, not by relighting: on ARM-B-class plates the FLAT composite already reaches control-parity integration (7.5 vs 6.5). Ship the styled-plate pipeline (plate-sprint) as the cohesion path. If the relight is ever revisited it needs a PER-PLATE depth/normal sidecar (rendered from that plate's own conditioning geometry), not the crude shared greybox — the shared-greybox-relights-detailed-plate banding is the binding defect. Diminishing returns: 4 A/B rounds (#1469 lost on registration; #1479 lost on black-voids; #1469-iter3 tied on a cool plate; #1481 the relight LOSES on the warm plate it was waiting for). No lever remains for the relight-shader; the win migrated to the plate pipeline. STOP.
